name: PS4/PS5 App - Superpower (formerly Cleanplay)
description: Sole owner of the PS4/PS5 app for a platform with 40K+ users across web and console. Responsibilities span feature development, backend maintenance, CI/CD pipelines, Sony platform deployment, and telemetry instrumentation.

name: Whimpact! - Level Headed Games | Scubalight Studios
description: Fall Guys-like multiplayer game built with an 11-person team. Architected the migration from a monolithic server to microservices — each game session now runs as an independent service — and engineered the enemy AI systems.

name: College Football 25 - Electronic Arts
description: Owned and shipped key Career Mode UI screens from scratch within a 50-person team. Part of a franchise with 200M+ downloads, these screens are played daily by millions of users.

name: Madden NFL - Electronic Arts
description: Implemented critical Career Mode UI screens from scratch as part of a 50-person team. These screens serve millions of active players in EA's flagship sports franchise with 200M+ downloads.

name: 0xMen - Rather Labs
description: WebGL blockchain fighting game built from scratch with a 15-person team. Engineered a real-time pipeline that fetches each player's NFT assets from the blockchain and renders them as unique, fully playable characters — enabling truly on-chain-driven gameplay.

name: Rhythm Realms - Agonalea Games
description: Led a 5-person team for 2 years to ship this Google Play Indie Games Fund award-winning rhythm game, reaching 50K+ downloads. Built the core rhythmic mechanics, loot box system, inventory, and season pass features.

name: Jumping Hamster - Deliver Games
description: A Doodle Jump-like Game, for PC Windows and Linux. Developed in Godot 3 in 2018.

name: Argentina Pelea - Debate Mortal - Deliver Games
description: A parody game of Argentine politicians. Developed with Unity3D.

name: Eggszy - Deliver Games
description: Android game developed in 2017 with Unity3D. I remastered it in 2020, adding some cool features like a skins system, ads, and in-app purchases.
